settings.proofreadModelHelp: Model used for proofread (OCR error suggestions).
settings.schedulerIntervalFloor: scheduler_interval_seconds must be at least 5 seconds.
settings.kaggleMinQueueHelp: Minimum queued jobs to spawn (loop mode); default 1.
settings.kaggleMinGapHelp: Minimum gap between two spawns; default 600.
settings.kaggleMinGapFloor: kaggle_min_gap_seconds must be at least 60 seconds.
settings.intro: Values are stored in the Setting table (runtime override) — applied immediately without a container restart; when the DB row is empty, env values are used.
settings.kaggleModeHelp: Read-only via API — changing mode requires a container restart.
settings.irModelHelp: Model used for IR document-structure classification (docx/md export).
settings.llmApiKeyHelp: Bearer token for /chat/completions. Leave blank to keep the current key.
settings.llmTimeoutHelp: Request timeout per LLM call; default 180, range 120–600.
settings.llmTimeoutFloor: llm_timeout must be at least 120 seconds.
settings.llmTimeoutCeiling: llm_timeout must be at most 600 seconds.
settings.purgeIntervalHelp: How often old jobs/files are purged; default 3600, minimum 60.
settings.purgeIntervalFloor: purge_interval_seconds must be at least 60 seconds.
settings.maxPagesHelp: Server-side page cap per uploaded PDF; default 100, minimum 1.
settings.dailyLimitHelp: Effective limit = the user's per-user column (empty → default 25). This Setting row is not read by quota enforcement yet.
settings.weeklyLimitHelp: Effective limit = the user's per-user column (empty → default 150). This Setting row is not read by quota enforcement yet.
settings.uploadByteLimitHelp: Max upload size, shown and entered in MB (stored as bytes); minimum 1 MB.
settings.purgeRetentionHelp: Keep finished jobs' files for N days before purging; default 7, minimum 1.
settings.purgeRetentionFloor: purge_retention_days must be at least 1 day.
settings.smtpHostHelp: Outgoing mail server hostname; default localhost.
settings.smtpUserHelp: SMTP auth username; blank = no auth.
settings.smtpPassHelp: SMTP auth password. Leave blank to keep the current password.

hero.title: Turn photos and PDFs into editable text
hero.sub: Scan exams, books, and documents into structured text. Fix problem areas and export the file you need.
hero.alt: img2text home page on a dark background
hero.caption: The whole page on a dark background.

s1.label: OCR reads the text
s1.body: Machines read photos and PDFs into raw text. Vietnamese diacritics supported.

s2.label: IR keeps the structure
s2.body: Text is organized into paragraphs, headings, tables, and lists. Fix each suspect region individually.

s3.label: Layout rebuilds the page
s3.body: The layout engine reassembles your fixes into a formatted page, keeping original columns and margins.

f1.title: Two-pane editing, undo everything
f1.body: Text and Layout open side by side. Every action is logged; Ctrl+Z steps back.

f2.title: Click to fix proofread errors
f2.body: Click a wrong spot in the preview to highlight the matching text in the image. Fix it in place without touching anything else.

f3.title: Six export formats
f3.body: Markdown, HTML, DOCX, PDF, plus layout-preserving copies of Markdown and DOCX.

f4.title: Transparent quota
f4.body: Pages remaining this month show right in the nav bar. No hidden costs.

f5.title: Prepare pages before running
f5.body: Pick pages, straighten rotated ones, and crop text areas in the wizard before submitting.
